comment: Would not recommend unless necessary. Made the mistake of taking him a second time. He stopped entering grades with over a month left in the semester, so you're left piecing together your final grade. Participation grading was also very unreasonable, I was never late, rarely missed speaking up in class, and still received a C-.

Took him for mgmt247, wasn't an option to select here. 
He uses an online tool for most activities and group projects. This class is a good intro course, you actually go and make a business plan and conduct interviews to validate your idea. The class is easy and interesting, and professor is a genuinely nice guy.
Very accommodating and a great professor!
